4 احقدهُ He, (a person, S, L,) or it, (a thing, L,) caused him to bear rancour, malevolence, malice, or spite, (ضِغْن,) [against another;] (S, L;) [caused him to hide enmity, and violent hatred, in his heart; (see 1;)] caused him to retain, or hold fast, enmity in his heart, watching for an opportunity to indulge it or exercise it [speedily]. (L, K.) ＝
-A2- احقد, intrans.: see 1, in two places. ―
-b2- احقدوا They sought to obtain something from a mine and found it not. (S, K: copied by J from a book, but not heard by him.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
